value.statedIntentSummary: This server declares two tools: one to fetch weather data by sending an HTTPS GET with city, units='metric', and appid=<OPENWEATHER_API_KEY> to either a loopback endpoint (default) or the live OpenWeather API (when SUREX_FIXTURE_WEATHER_LIVE=1), and another to report which endpoint is in effect without making any request; it explicitly states that no files are read, subprocesses started, or runtime code loaded.
